faq.answer: Choose a service in the Square scheduler, select an available appointment and follow the booking steps. Review the service details and booking terms before confirming.
faq.question: How do I book an appointment?

faq.answer: Use Open Square Booking to open the same scheduler directly. You can also text 262-939-9325 for help choosing a service.
faq.question: What if the booking menu does not load?

faq.answer: Explore our massage, facial, Japanese Head Spa, lash, waxing and wellness pages for treatment details. If you are unsure which option fits, text us before booking.
faq.question: Which service should I choose?

faq.answer: The introductory facial is for guests new to Matrix facial services, including existing massage, Head Spa and wellness guests who have not had a facial here. Read the full offer terms before booking.
faq.question: Who qualifies for the introductory facial offer?

faq.answer: Reserve the recommended 60-minute Custom Facial follow-up before leaving your introductory appointment. It is arranged at checkout, subject to availability, and cannot be combined with other promotions.
faq.question: How do I receive the $85 facial follow-up?

faq.answer: All appointments are at Matrix Massage & Bodywork, 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. We welcome guests from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Twin Lakes, Kenosha, Union Grove and nearby Antioch.
faq.question: Where is my appointment?

faq.answer: Check your Square confirmation for appointment-management options and the booking terms. If you need assistance, text 262-939-9325. Cancellation and rescheduling policies shown during booking apply.
faq.question: How do I change an appointment?
